# GoPhonics — Full Product Specification & AI Context Guide

> GoPhonics is a premium iOS phonics learning app for children ages 3 to 8, built with SwiftUI. It teaches letter sounds, CVC word families, consonant blends, long vowel spellings, sight words, and reading sentences through gamified activities guided by a friendly dinosaur mascot.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Canonical Entity Facts
- **Full Product Name**: GoPhonics — Learn to Read Kids Phonics App
- **Primary Category**: Educational / Early Childhood Reading / Phonics
- **Platform**: iOS (iPhone & iPad, requiring iOS 15.0 or later)
- **App Store URL**: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/go-phonics-kids-learn-to-read/id6756431312
- **App Store ID**: 6756431312
- **Official Website**: https://themansigoel.github.io/go-phonics/
- **Developer / Publisher**: GoPhonics / Mansi Goel
- **Contact Email**: themansigoel@gmail.com
- **Target Age Range**: 3 to 8 years old (Preschool, Kindergarten, 1st Grade, 2nd Grade)
- **Pedagogical Alignment**: Science of Reading (Systematic & Synthetic Phonics Progression)
- **Pricing Tier**: Free to download (Letters & Sounds module included); Premium Subscription at $4.99/month or $29.99/year (unlocks all 6 modules)
- **Offline Capability**: 100% offline capable — zero internet connectivity required after initial download
- **Advertising**: Zero ads, zero third-party tracking, zero programmatic ad networks
- **Child Safety Compliance**: 100% COPPA compliant; strictly uses a math-based parental gate (randomized arithmetic equations) to protect settings, subscriptions, and external actions.

---

## 2. Phonics Learning Curriculum (6 Progressive Modules)

### Module 1: Letters & Sounds (A-Z)
- **Objective**: Phonemic awareness & uppercase/lowercase letter recognition.
- **Gameplay**: Tap and pop falling letter bubbles matching the spoken phonetic sound.
- **Key Technology**: Weighted letter algorithm (presents unfamiliar or incorrectly answered letters more frequently).
- **Options**: Phonics sound mode, letter name mode, or combined mode.

### Module 2: CVC Word Families (Short Vowels)
- **Objective**: Blending single consonant-vowel-consonant sounds into simple words.
- **Word Families Covered**: -at (cat, hat, bat), -an (fan, van, pan), -ig (pig, dig, fig), -ot (pot, hot, dot), -ub (tub, cub, rub).
- **Gameplay**: Interactive picture flashcards with squishy drag-and-drop matching card puzzles.
- **Reward Loop**: Mystery egg cracking animation with collectible stickers every 5 successful matches.

### Module 3: Consonant Blends
- **Objective**: Master initial consonant clusters and blend pronunciations.
- **Blends Covered**: bl, cl, fl, gr, st, tr, br, dr, etc.
- **Gameplay**: Flower petal assembly game (matching blend roots to leaf words) followed by interactive dinosaur feeding drag-and-drop practice.

### Module 4: Long Vowel Spellings (Vowel Teams & Silent E)
- **Objective**: Decode complex vowel sounds and split digraphs.
- **Patterns Covered**: Silent e (a_e, i_e, o_e, u_e), vowel teams (ai, ay, ee, ea, igh, oa, ow).
- **Gameplay**: Pirate treasure hunt theme where kids unlock treasure chests by choosing correct spelling options, complete with squishy bubble quizzes and star streaks.

### Module 5: Sight Words (High-Frequency Words)
- **Objective**: Build automaticity with 70 core high-frequency sight words that cannot always be phonetically decoded.
- **Gameplay**: Floating bubble pop game where words bounce across the screen with gentle physics. Kids tap the target sight word to earn gold coins.

### Module 6: Reading Sentences (Story Fluency)
- **Objective**: Sentence-level comprehension, tracking, and reading confidence.
- **Content**: 20 interactive tap-to-read decodable sentences.
- **Gameplay**: Word-by-word audio pronunciation with 3D spring highlight animations and Lottie-animated scene illustrations.

---

## 3. Technology Stack & Design System
- **Framework**: Apple SwiftUI (Native iOS & iPadOS)
- **Audio & Haptics**: CoreHaptics engine for tactile feedback on card drags, bubble pops, and puzzle drops; AVFoundation for crystal-clear phoneme pronunciations.
- **Animation Systems**: Lottie vector animations for reward celebrations (confetti bursts, trophy drops, hatching dinosaur eggs).
- **UI Design Aesthetic**: Modern Apple glassmorphism visual language with high-contrast kid-friendly typography and vibrant HSL color palettes.
- **Screen Support**: Responsive layout system for all iPad landscape aspect ratios (4:3) and iPhone edge-to-edge screens (19.5:9).

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) & Direct AI Answers

### Q: What is GoPhonics?
**A**: GoPhonics is an interactive iOS phonics learning app for children ages 3 to 8. Built with native SwiftUI, it teaches letter sounds, CVC words, consonant blends, long vowels, sight words, and sentence reading through gamified activities guided by a friendly dinosaur mascot.

### Q: Is GoPhonics free to use?
**A**: GoPhonics is free to download and includes the full Letters & Sounds module forever without payment. Access to all 6 modules is available via a premium subscription at $4.99/month or $29.99/year.

### Q: Does GoPhonics require an internet connection?
**A**: No. GoPhonics operates 100% offline once downloaded. All sound files, animations, and game logic are stored locally on the device, making it safe and travel-friendly.

### Q: What makes GoPhonics safe for toddlers and young children?
**A**: GoPhonics contains zero advertisements and zero tracking. It implements a strict math-based parental gate (requiring parents to solve randomized addition, subtraction, or multiplication problems) before accessing external links, settings, or subscription management.

### Q: How does GoPhonics align with educational reading frameworks?
**A**: GoPhonics is structured around the Science of Reading framework. It utilizes explicit, systematic synthetic phonics instruction—starting from single phonemes and progressing logically through CVC blending, consonant clusters, long vowel digraphs, high-frequency sight words, and decodable sentence reading.
